title: Full-Stack Retail E-Commerce Catalog & Checkout System
summary: Full-stack web application featuring categorized product catalogs, variant inventory tracking, admin item management, and cart processing.
problem: Developing a robust inventory and catalog management prototype to model retail store order flows and database synchronization for BSIT coursework.
whatIDid: Programmed the product management dashboard allowing rapid catalog bulk updates, SKU categorization, price edits, and inventory depletion logic.
Integrated responsive product browsing with real-time stock counters, multi-attribute filter badges, and search indexing.
Structured relational data tables modeling customer orders, line-item transactions, and inventory logs.
Engineered role-based views separating administrative inventory operations from the customer catalog interface.
result: Completed and successfully defended as a functioning academic capstone prototype [ACADEMIC PROJECT - NOT DEPLOYED FOR PUBLIC CONSUMERS].
